bundle.shortDescription: Private messaging for friends and groups
bundle.longDescription: PrivCord is a private messenger for friends and groups. Add a friend with a QR code, then chat directly over an encrypted WebRTC or Bluetooth link. No accounts and no server that reads your messages.
